comment.body: Thanks for describing the backup restore and the off/on workaround. Which two specific utilities did you test, and after starting PowerToys do they show as enabled in Settings before you toggle them? If practical, does the same happen with a fresh PowerToys settings profile without importing the backup? Please do not share the backup itself unless its contents have been reviewed for private information.
